title: Timeframes
caption:
Same stock. Three completely different charts. How?

It's the timeframe. Each candle can cover seconds or a whole day. Zoom out, and the noise smooths into the bigger trend. Many traders use longer candles to see the trend, and shorter ones to time the entry.

Meme Street's charts go from 30-second candles to one-year candles. Practise at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

narration: Same stock, three completely different charts. How? It's the timeframe. Each candle can cover a few seconds, or a whole day. Group three candles into one, then six, and the noise smooths out. Same market, different zoom. Many traders use longer candles to see the big trend, and shorter ones to time their entry.
